material_change_from_PDSG_COMP_001: Only the owner and prospectively declared local dependency factors are forwarded or differentiated by the scheduling statistic; non-neighbor actor blocks remain outside its autograd graph.

measurement.baseline: forward only owner-local factors and compute one owner actor gradient
measurement.alignment_hvp: retain the same local graph and take one joint reverse derivative of the alignment scalar with respect to all local donor blocks
measurement.outside_support_check: at least one non-neighbor parameter block must be unused by the alignment graph

mandatory_gates.L1: all timing and derivative values are finite and strictly positive
mandatory_gates.L2: every local donor derivative is nonzero and every probed non-neighbor parameter is unused by the alignment graph
mandatory_gates.L3: median across-configuration HVP-to-baseline time ratio is at most 2.5
mandatory_gates.L4: maximum configuration HVP-to-baseline time ratio is at most 4.0
mandatory_gates.L5: at fixed local degree, width, and batch, the maximum across-agent-count HVP median divided by the minimum is at most 1.35
mandatory_gates.L6: within each agent-count, width, and batch cell, each adjacent local-degree HVP median ratio is at most 2.2
mandatory_gates.L7: only after L1-L6 pass, one clean same-machine rerun must preserve every gate decision and reproduce the aggregate median and maximum timing ratios within 15 percent

stopping_rule: Any failure among L1-L6 stops reproduction and successor learning experiments. No threshold, grid, timing count, or seed may change after the primary execution.
